用.hint: Depicts a bucket with a handle on the right side. Based on the original meaning "bucket". The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "use".

甫.hint: Pictograph of something sprouting (屮) from a field (田), depicting a garden or orchard, now written as 圃. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

由.hint: Depicts a kind of helmet worn by warriors. Based on the original meaning "helmet", now written as 胄. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

甲.hint: Origin unclear. Possibly depicts cracks on a shell or tree bark.

申.hint: Depicts a lightning bolt. Based on the original meaning "lightning". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

电.hint: Simplified form of 電, which depicts lightning (申) during a rainstorm (雨). The 雨 component was deleted for simplification.

甶.hint: Depicts a skull or the top of a head of a person. Same in origin to 囟.

男.hint: Traditionally males (男) were the people who plowed (力) the fields (田).

components.hint: Depicts a plow.

甸.hint: Same in origin to 佃. Depicts a person (勹) working in the fields (田). 田 also represents the sound. The meaning later shifted to "crops" and "suburbs of capital".

番.hint: Depicts an animal's claw (釆) with their paw shown. 釆 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "animal's paw", now written as 蹯. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
